avis.titre: It is a great eye cream
avis.texte: I have used this for a long time and my eye area looks years younger than I actually am.

I have been using Clinique products since 1980 and this eye cream really does de puff, help with dark eye circles, and hydrate the eye area for hours….I am always told that I look 15-20 yrs younger then I am. Give it a try, you won't be disappointed!!!
I have used this product for over 26 years. Do I have to say anymore. It's the best cream for around the eyes.
I buy this to help reduce and eliminate wrinkles underneath my eyes. I use it every day and love it.

avis.titre: I would buy this over and over
avis.texte: Love this eye cream would recommend to all my friend because it works, I have noticed the improvement in one week. Clinique is a product you can count on to do its job.

First of all, I absolutely cannot stand the texture of this product. Some may call it "lightweight," but I've used lightweight or gel eyecreams that I've had no issue with in the past. This isn't quite a gel, it's just a strange, silicone-y, serum-y but also creamy texture that just doesn't sit well on the skin. It also burns the eyes. With every single use. No matter how hard I try to avoid getting it in my eyes, they water and sting for at least 20 minutes post application. And I used this product for 6+ months and saw absolutely no changes in the appearance of my undereyes, so it's safe to say the effectiveness claims can be debunked.

avis.titre: I have been using this product for years!
avis.texte: This is my favorite eye cream of all time. It goes on like silk and leaves my eye area feeling soft and moisturized. I am 74 years old and find this cream is by far the best I've ever used. I'm happy to say that I have kept crows feet at bay, and I truly believe it's because I have faithfully used this eye cream.

I absolutely LOVE this eye cream. LOVE LOVE LOVE!!!!💗 I am healing from an eye "situation" And this has kept me sane. My skin is very sensitive in general; with what I'm dealing with, this has given me times of relief and comfort. No reaction to it. No scent; which is key. I COMPLETELY recommend this to everyone; especially if you are hypersensitive and want moisture on the eyes. Zero doubt. Get it.

This is my favorite under-eye moisturizer. My skin is sensitive and thin. This product works perfectly with both this conditions. I don't give it 5 stars because I think it's overpriced. But when I can afford it, I love it.
I cant truly rate the product as I never received it. My order was returned by carrier. When I requested to replace order with original discount price i was refused. Very dissatisfied.

I bought this lets say 2 months ago and since then Ive been using it every night and every morning to get rid of my eyebags. I dont need a becore and after picture because nothing has changed yes the cream hydrates but its done nothing to ccure my eyebags.

avis.texte: I've tried tons of eye creams and I love this Clinique one. It's very creamy but yet light and feels really hydrating under my eyes. I have oily mature skin. I've used this both in the evening and mornings and it's great under make up.
I've used this for years. It is absolutely the best product I've ever used for dark circles. It's soothing and works fast.

I can't say enough about this eye cream. I have been using it for years and have concluded that this eye cream is the only one for me. It goes on so silky smooth and blends beautifully into the skin. The hydration is wonderful….keeping my eye area moist, but not sticky all day. I love this product.

avis.titre: best eye cream just got better!
avis.texte: I've always loved All About Eyes eye cream, and now I love it even more with the addition of vitamin C. Has been part of my skincare routine for more years than I can count!

So, about a year and a half ago I received "All about eyes" as a sample. I gave it a try and loved it! It refreshed my eyes all around. I raved about it to everyone. Once I ran out I had to wait a while to purchase another one as it's a bit expensive for my budget. Being it worked so well I made sure I eventually got it. I've been using it now for 2 months faithfully...every day, twice a day. Sadly it hasn't done anything at all to help this time. My eyes look exactly the same as they did 2 months ago. I don't know if the ingredients changed but what a HUGE disappointment. Such a waste of money.

I bought this lets say 2 months ago and since then Ive been using it every night and every morning to get rid of my eyebags. I dont need a becore and after picture because nothing has changed yes the cream hydrates but its done nothing to ccure my eyebags.

I've been using this eye cream for years--I tried the rich formula (which my mom likes) but this is best for me. This formula soaks in quickly and is very soothing. It is the only cream I have found that is safe for eyelids and has never irritated my eyes. Also really helped with eczema around my eyes that occurred a few years ago.
I love how moisturized my under eye area is when I use this product. When it's fully absorbed, the skin is so soft!

avis.titre: Changed the formula and it is not good!
avis.texte: I have been using this eye cream for years. They must have changed the formula because the last two brand new jars I got, when I put the cream on in the morning the next morning I wake up with tiny red welts all over my eyes in the areas I put it and the welts last for days. So not happy about this at all! Clinique keeps doing this and one by one the products I've used for years I suddenly can't use anymore. What a waste. I'm upset and I'm down to only one eye cream from Clinique that I can now use.
Love it this cream does not irritate my skin and leaves me moisturized
I really love this product and how smooth my skin feels. It's one of my favorite moisturizers for my face. I really love it.
This will forever be part of my nightly routine. I've been using this eye cream for years and notice a big difference in puffiness and under eye wrinkles.
This product does a great job on your dark circles and bags Well worth the money

I have tried many underage creams but I keep coming back to Clinique All About Eyes. It helps to diminish fine lines and wake up tired eyes. I don't think anything affordable will eliminate the under eye bags but this eye cream helps to minimize them.

I recently purchased this online and once I received it, I used it the first night. I noticed a significant difference in the morning and for the next several days however, it hasn't been working as good as it was initially would I buy it again? I'm not sure but I like it right now
I did not see nor feel the eye cream experience many talk about.
This eye cream has a nice texture, applies smoothly, feels hydrating and cooling under the eyes, and works well under makeup.

I like the texture of this eye cream. It's a smooth application and does well under my concealer and other makeup. It's hydrating and has a cooling effect to the under eye area. I only see a very slight lightening of my dark circles. All in all it's a good eye cream and I will continue to use this product.

avis.titre: I have bought this product again and again!
avis.texte: This eye cream, by far, does more for my under eye area than any other product I've tried! It keeps my skin hydrated, calm, less redness and dark circles, and no irritating fragrance near my sensitive eyes! I'm a longtime fan!

I received this as a free gift and I love it! It hydrates eyes and reduces puffiness. I see sum of the dark circles minimizing but I haven't used too long. Unfortunately, I need to return an item so it's forcing me to return this free gift. I will repurchase it! I never knew how much hydration my eyes needed until I received this item!

avis.titre: A little goes a long way
avis.texte: I love this cream. It's moist soft, and light. You need just a little bit because a little covers a lot. I will be buy in another one.
I received this as a gift with purchase and I love it. It's so light and glides smoothly on my skin. Now I need to get more!
Been using this product for almost 2 weeks, I've noticed my eyes aren't so puffy.

avis.titre: Very soothing as I had some kind of allergic reaction.
avis.texte: This reaction affected my eyelids and they turned red and skin was very dry.

avis.titre: i enjoy this item and will be repurchasing

Bought this once during beauty steals and loved it! Moisturizing and sets in quickly so I can apply my concealer without waiting forever. Perfect for busy mornings!

I have tried so many different eye creams but I keep returning to this Clinique All About Eyes because it has the perfect amount of moisture. I can wear this in the heat and humidity of Summer without it feeling heavy or greasy.

avis.titre: Does not improve my undereye bags at all.
avis.texte: The texture is nice and smooths my skin but it does not reduce the swelling under my eyes. I'm really disappointed in this product.

avis.titre: I continue to buy this product
avis.texte: Just the perfect cooling feeling my eye area needs. Feels great.
It's part of my daily routine. I have been buying this cream for several years now. I recommend

I've been using this for years but with aging am seeing more dark circles and so was looking around for a different Clinique eye cream. This has recently been promoted as +Vitamin C and was recommended to me by a Clinique consultant after I completed a skin analysis, so I ordered it, thinking it was a newer version of the product. But no, I don't see Vitamin C (or ascorbic acid) listed anywhere in the ingredients. I still find it a soothing product but am disappointed that there is no new benefit. If I had known this before ordering, I would have tried a different eye cream.
Not the first time that I have used this product. Really like it.
Does not work. Been using for over 4 months and nothing. I have mow fine lines on my eye than before and they are always dry.

Absolutely love 'All about eyes' it's very delicate for my sensitive skin. If you have sensitive puffy eyes, this is the eye cream for you. A little goes a long way. I use it morning and night. Great for dark circles and allergy eyes.

Clinique's miracle working eye treatment provides skin-smoothing, de-puffing and rejuvenation in one gentle, sleek and elegant formula. With a battalion of botanical and other beneficial ingredients, this comforting cream offers both immediate and long-term care to weary peepers for a difference you can feel…and "C!"

avis.titre: Second jar, so far so good
avis.texte: I'm in my early 30s and I've been noticing some lines around my eyes. I decided to try this because I love Clinique, and it did not disappoint. I love that it absorbs quickly and hydrates well.
This is my favorite eye cream so far. I love the consistency and texture, no smell, no stinging. I feel like it helps with puffiness and keeps my eyes moisturized. I'm in my 3rd jar.

I've been using all about eyes for 15+ years. It's my go to eye cream that has always been faithful to me. People usually think I'm younger than I am. I credit this product for keeping my skin hydrated and preventing deeper lines from forming. My skin is extremely sensitive, and I've never had a problem with this beloved cream.
I got a sample of this & I absolutely loved the results I just bought my first jar and I am going to order one for my mother too
I have tried a lot of eye creams and this really works! It absorbs quickly and I saw results within a few days!
I'm 33 and needed to upgrade my eye cream. I love this one! It feels great on my skin and my eyes look brighter and less puffy.
I love this eye cream because it is emollient & feels good on my dry skin.
I bought this for the puffiness under my eyes. It is very smooth and nice to apply.

Never in my life did I think I would buy an eye cream at this price, but it is so worth it. I have severe sensitive skin and many allergies to skincare, and this eye cream works so good on my skin. I see my under eyes are hydrated, less swollen, circles are lighter in color, and doesn't pill under makeup! I love this product and has been lasting me awhile. So worth it.

avis.titre: I have bought this product for over 30 years.
avis.texte: Continue to buy this product over 30 years. Love it fragrance free.
Love this eye cream. SUPER moisturizing for the delicate eye area.
Love this eye cream! It doesn't flake like some when I put makeup on top. Also blends in nicely whenever I use it.

I am 43 and I was hoping to replace Advanced Génifique Wrinkle & Dark Circle Eye Cream with this as it is quite spendy, however, it dried out my under eye skin and will be returning it. I have re-purchased my usual cream and skin is looking better. I wish this would have worked for me as you do get a lot of product for the price.
Luv this eye cream. Works great helps smooth under eyes. It's a bit expensive tho.
This is an amazing eye cream! It's super hydrating, and feels great! I definitely recommend this eye cream!

I wish i could give this product zero stars… i always use the same products on my face and never have any issues. Decided to try this cream and ive had a bruise, itching and swelling on my eye for three days now… it hurts and it's not going away! :\

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: this product works well for under eye puffiness!!!!!!!! This product reduces under eye puffiness!!!!!!!!!! This product is affordable!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! I will buy this product again!!!!!!!!! Thank you Clinique !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

This is an absolute must for my skin care routine. I love this eye cream, it goes on like silk, absorbs immediately, and make can easily go over with caking. It does work well for fatigue, and to help smooth the fine lines. I love this product and have used it for many years.
This moisturizes and is absorbed in the skin without being greasy.
I have used this product for several years. I love this moisturizer as I have dry skin.

This is the beat eye cream that I've used (and I've tried a lot). It feels great going on and you notice a difference immediately. I use in AM and PM and have also noticed an overall improvement over time. It also doesn't make my eyes water or burn like some I've tried in the past. It is a little pricey considering how little the jar is and how much you use, but it definitely works!

avis.titre: clinique it's all about the eyes
avis.texte: I only used this product for a few days and I actually want to put it on my whole face. I love it

avis.titre: Contains the most common allergen/free sample no ingredients
avis.texte: I received this as a gift with purchase and it contains whey protein - milk is the most common food allergen. I have anaphylactic allergies to milk proteins!! Label label label and put milk in bold!!!

I've been super down about my puffy eyes, dark cirlces and my sunken eye look. I tried different eye creams, this one is AMAZING! It brightens so beautifully and truly DEPUFFS! Like for real! I purchased less than a week ago, I am super satisfied and happier when I look in the mirror. I also end up putting a small amount on my lips. I know we each respond differently to eye creams but I HIGHLY recommend this one !
This product really helps the eye area to be and feel hydrated, making you look better, brighter eyes.
I've used All About Eyes since it was invented. It is the best and I will continue to always use it!
All About Eyes does exactly what it says it will do. My eyes actually look healthier.

avis.titre: Clinique "All About Eyes" - the only eye cream I use!
avis.texte: I have exclusively used Clinique "All About Eyes" eye cream for over a decade now. Prior to discovering this great product, I would sometimes have allergic reactions to other brand eye creams. Clinique is rich and creamy, and does a great job. I never have any redness or swelling with this cream.

I used to be obsessed with this cream! I just bought a new jar and have noticed the skin around my eyes burning so bad after applying it! It hurts so bad!! Soo disappointed! It used to be the only cream that worked for my undereyes!

i mainly bought this product to get rid of my eye bags. and although, it hasn't done so yet I feel like I see a little bit of improvement. what doesn't help is that I don't sleep but it does have a creamy texture to it, which i love! def worth a buy tho!

avis.titre: THIS PRODUCT HAS HELPED WITH MY BAGGY EYES
avis.texte: In just one week of use, I have seen the difference, although I have also improved my routine by going to bed early so I can get up early, but not before doing my skincare routine. It is necessary to change our habits so that the products we buy work, at least that is what I have seen. Before I bought products that did nothing because I did not combine them with my habits. Even so, these are the only ones that have worked 100%. Very good, I almost have no dark circles anymore.

Like most of you I've tried all sorts of eye creams, from drugstore to brands to high end brands, and this is definitely my go-to product. It's just the right amount of creamy and absorbs so well into my skin.

I usually use IT Cosmetics Bye Bye Under Eye Cream coupled with Teamine from Revision, but as I buy Clinique for all other cosmetic needs, I decided to try this product with the vitamin c. As a 51 yr old woman, my skin is naturally wrinkling around the eyes. The Bye Bye under eye cream is a bit tacky and doesn't go on smooth, so it never feels sufficiently hydrating. In addition, putting makeup on over it never looked natural. The Teamine product is extremely moisturizing but it breaks the bank. Enter this product and talk about a GAME CHANGER!! Makeup goes smoothly over it, my eyes don't get peely skin at the corners, and after 8 hours, my under eye area still looks bright! I tossed the $$$ Teamine and only use the IT Bye Bye when I don't wear powder or base. I ALWAYS wear the Clinique and my under eyes feel so soft and moisturized. I love this stuff!!! Will never look back!
Purchased a small size to try. At first, I didn't notice any change but by after using daily, my eye lids are firmer and the crepeness has disappeared.

avis.titre: Always have to have on hand
avis.texte: Love this product to help with dark circles under my eye. Adds moisturizer that I need.

I have hereditary dark circles and I can tell a difference but they still aren't great. If you have typical dark circles, this would totally fix them. I also love how hydrating it it. I don't have any issues using it before makeup as well.
Any time I try another product, I always came back to All About Eyes!

avis.titre: The end all be all of eye creams
avis.texte: I swear I have tried so many eye treatments and spent so much money and everything is either ineffective or causes an allergic reaction or both. I don't care how much it costs I'm never buying another eye treatment again. Does everything it claims. The skin around my eyes is so soft, hydrated, lighted and no puffiness. Best of all no itchy, inflamed allergic reaction. Clinique will always be my go to for skin care.

I've been using Clinique All about eyes cream for years. It's super moisturizing and takes away dark circles and puffiness. I have older skin and I swear it targets my fine lines as well. It's a great eye cream if you have sensitive skin. I'll keep buying this cream the minute I run out!
This is an excellent eye cream. Feels very light and hydrating.
After 3 years of using this, I haven't seen much change in appearance. It makes my skin feel soft, but is it worth the money for the amount of product? Not really.

I always want to try this eye cream so when it went on sale Ipurchase…plus have good reviews, but for some reason, I don't see any different on my puffiness plus make my concealer crease i'm not going to change my concealer because that's my favorite one so for me this cream it's not working
